items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Cobblestone. Fixed a spot in princess tower where the bomb could be thrown out of reach. Fixed some bad wall bang locations Fixes for smoother player movement throughout the level. Fixed some bad boosts and walkable ledges. Fixed a location at B where grenades could fall through the world. Fixed various gaps in the world. Fixed third-person silent reload animations to play at correct speed Various stability improvements

items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: Cobblestone. Fixed some walkable ledges in long AFixed map issue that was loading an empty skybox. Fixed an audio blocker issue by mid/AAdded a grenade clip to assault van bumper. Fixed various gaps in the world Inferno. Fixed grenade and Molotov exploit spot from church to dark on bombsite B.. Updated slow reload animation for the AWPOptimized ground burn decals under smoke on very high graphics settings. Players in Switzerland will have an X-Ray Scanner tab in their Inventory. For those players, containers can only be opened via X-Ray Scanner. items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.body: The PGL Singapore 2026 Major Hub is now available. Visit the hub to purchase tournament items, play the Pick'Em Challenge, and more. Purchase a Singapore 2026 Viewer Pass to receive an upgradable Singapore 2026 Coin. With an active pass, you can upgrade your coin and earn rewards by playing the Pick'Em Challenge. Additionally, you will show up on the Active Pass Leaderboard where you can compare your Pick'Em Challenge performance to your friends. Added Cobblestone map to official Casual, Competitive, Wingman, Retakes, and Deathmatch matchmaking. Removed Boulder, Fachwerk, and Shelter from official matchmaking pool. Added 8 new music kits from Monstercat. Fixed head dipping too low at

items.title: The Cobbled Road to Singapore
items.body: Today's update features the return of a legendary map. Welcome back, Cobblestone! Cobblestone veterans will feel at home in familiar locations like drop, chicken coop, and stables. But don't get cold feet, the map has undergone changes and features new pathways and locations for players to master. And it's cold now, so watch your crunchy footsteps as you trudge through the snow to the bombsites. Cobblestone can be found in Competitive, Wingman, and in its own map group in Casual, Deathmatch, and Retakes. items.body: Fixed some cases of popping and glitching when switching weapons and reloading at extreme angles. Fixed bot pathing issue in Retakes game mode. Fixed a rendering hang on DX11Improved avx / avx512 instruction set detection Miscellaneous stability and performance improvements
